verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, with the same flaws in both. The Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an illegible speck in the top-left corner of the card. The 'See the Schedule' button and the legal line are tiny and jammed into the bottom-right corner, which buries the call to action. The body copy is about as prominent as the headline, so they compete for attention. The book cover is squeezed narrower than the original's square shape. A's book is slightly less distorted than B's, so A wins narrowly, even though B wraps the body copy more evenly ('toast all night.' versus A's dangling 'all night.').
